justification.intent: Preserve exact categorical integer class codes (10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 95, 100); no interpolation between class codes is meaningful

alternatives.why_not: Continuous interpolation of categorical codes would create meaningless intermediate values, corrupting land-cover class assignments

choice.rationale: WorldCover is a categorical dataset; nearest-neighbour is the only resampling method that preserves the original class codes without introducing spurious intermediate values
choice.tradeoffs: Minor positional shift of class boundaries at sub-pixel scale; acceptable given the display-only purpose
